charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1101_010:
On [EN:Gen Ref="255" M="his" F="her" ] way back from exploring,
[Name:PlayerNickname ] ran into
Jupiter.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_030:
You look kind of happy. Did something
good happen?
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_040:
You won against a tough opponent in a
team battle?
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_060:
You do seem stronger than the last time I
saw you.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_070:
By that, I don’t mean that you’ve only gotten
stronger at battling.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_080:
Your bond as a sync pair seems stronger,
too.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_090:
Being good at battling with strong Pokémon
isn’t all there is to being a Pokémon Trainer.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_100:
A Trainer can only be considered strong
once they’ve developed skills worthy of their
Pokémon.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_110:
So if Pokémon are trying to get stronger for
their Trainers...
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_120:
then we Trainers need to live up to those
expectations.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_140:
Are you measuring up to your Pokémon as
they try to get stronger?
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_0402_180:
What a modest response. I guess you have a
sweet side after all.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_190:
Maybe we’re the ones who need to put in
some extra effort.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_200: Let’s both keep striving to improve.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_220:
It’s not just your Pokémon’s expectations you
have to meet.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_230: After all, on Pasio you battle as a team.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_240:
When you’re part of a team—or any kind of
group—you have to keep meeting
expectations to fulfill your role.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_250:
I guess that’s one thing you have in common
with those of us in Team Galactic.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_260:
It applies to me, too, as someone who works
for Master Cyrus.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_270:
It’s a lot of pressure having to meet the
expectations of a team...
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_280:
but it gives me energy to push myself to
become stronger.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_290:
So I’ll keep my expectations high for you
going forward.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_300:
Let’s see whether you make it or break
down under the pressure.
charaepi_ch0226_00_jupiter/2301_1201_310: Hehe. Well, give it everything you’ve got.
